arena: [분담] Guardian of the Forgotten Queen replaces Guardian of Ancient Kings and makes the target ally immune to all damage for 6 sec. Use it on the ally the enemy burst is focused on.

[차단] Avenger's Shield only interrupts non-player targets, so interrupt player casts with Rebuke. With Shield of Virtue active, your next Avenger's Shield interrupts and silences all enemies within 8 yds of the target.
[생존기] Ardent Defender reduces damage taken by 30% for 12 sec and lets you survive one fatal hit at 20% health. Pop it first when you're being focused.
[생존기] Divine Shield, Lay on Hands and Blessing of Protection leave Forbearance for 30 sec. Plan the order so you don't chain them on the same target.

[제어] Hammer of Justice stuns a target within 10 yds for 6 sec, and Blinding Light disorients enemies within 10 yds for 6 sec but damage can break it. Use them on the enemy healer your team isn't hitting.
[분담] Blessing of Sacrifice reduces an ally's damage taken by 30% for 12 sec and transfers that damage to you. Use it on a focused ally while your own defensive is active.

[위치] Blessing of Freedom grants immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec. With Bear the Burden, each Word of Glory reduces Blessing of Freedom's cooldown by 4 sec, but its healing on allies is reduced by 50%.
bg: [참고] In 8-player Battleground Blitz groups there are 0-1 tanks, and slow tanks need help carrying the flag. Extend Divine Steed by 2 sec with Steed of Glory and carry while immune to movement impairing effects.
[제어] During Steed of Glory you knock back enemies you move through, but feared or disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Run through enemies without CC on them.
[분담] With Hallowed Ground, Consecration clears and suppresses slows on allies inside it. Stand your flag carrier or base defenders on Consecration.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, keep Shield of the Righteous armor and Ardent Defender damage reduction chained without gaps.
[분담] Guardian of the Forgotten Queen gives the target ally 6 sec of damage immunity. Use it right before your flag carrier goes down.
[제어] Searing Glare makes enemy players in a 25 yd cone miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec. Aim it at enemy packs rushing a base.
pvpTalents: Guardian of the Forgotten Queen, picked by 26 of the top 27 Solo Shuffle and 25 of 36 Battleground Blitz players, protects one ally from all damage for 6 sec. Shield of Virtue, picked by 23 of 27 Solo Shuffle players, makes your next Avenger's Shield interrupt and silence all enemies around the target. Steed of Glory, picked by 21 of 36 Battleground Blitz players, extends Divine Steed by 2 sec and adds movement impairment immunity and knockbacks.
